comparison.objective: Cock a desoldering pump and leave it ready in its bench cradle; candidate fractures and recovers insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Compressing and latching a spring-loaded tool, then cradling it, versus stabilizing a mandrel during hammer impact and retrieving fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Pump remains cocked and cradled versus four contact-driven fractures with all tangs contained and coils retained. Cocking/scoring thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both involve impulse-capable tools, this task tests spring latching and safe placement rather than external impact fracture.
